newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish shares seen 8.0 pct up by end-1997.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish shares seen 8.0 pct up by end-1997.

text.p: Leading Danish share prices are expected to rise by an average 8.0 percent by end-December 1997, according to a Reuter consensus of analysts' forecasts issued on Thursday.
Fourteen analysts saw the Copenhagen bourse's top-20 KFX index rising to between 131 and 147.4 at the end of December next year, an average of 142 -- compared to Thursday's closing 130.97.
They forecast an average of 132 by end-March 1997 rising to 136 by end-June 1997, as economic growth improves.

Industry, building and construction sector and service and trade paper were poised for the most palpaple gains, while banking, insurance and to a certain extent shipping shares were seen by the panel as doing less well in the 12-month period.
The KFX index has risen 23.4 percent so far in 1996.
